results.text: Half Action only on the next turn.

Stunned for [[2d10]] rounds. Strength, Toughness and Agility halved (rounding up) until medical treatment. Fellowship permanently reduced by [[2d5]].

The target dies. If he carried ammunition, roll [[1d10]]: on 6 or higher it explodes, and everyone within [[1d5]] metres takes a single hit of [[1d10+5]] Explosive damage to a random location. Carried grenades or missiles detonate one round later.
